fields.description: The number the line is referred to by. Result lines point at these.

fields.description: How the line is printed, e.g. Gesamtleistung.

fields.description: Which way is up for this line. On an account line it decides whether the figure reads as revenue or as cost; on a result line it decides whether the total is printed as it stands or the other way round, so that a cost total can be printed positive.
fields.label: Sign

fields.description: One account number or range per line, e.g. 4100-4199. Lines starting with # are notes.
fields.label: Accounts

fields.description: First account line that counts towards this result.
fields.label: From Row

fields.description: Last account line that counts towards this result.
fields.label: To Row

fields.description: The line this one is expressed as a percentage of.
fields.label: Reference Row
